in_sanskrit.name: Bholu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Foolish, Simple
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bholu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Bholu is a name derived from the word 'bhol', which means foolish or simple. This name is often given to children who possess a pure and innocent heart, free from worldly wisdom and cunning.
